summary: Root cause was an async render race, not duplicate durable source data: concurrent decorateNow() calls could all remove before awaiting the shared load promise and then each prepend an Activity Board. Fixed with a post-load render-generation fence plus defensive work_unit_id identity dedupe that preserves distinct IDs. Added a deterministic source/projection uniqueness fixture and a Chromium stress check invoking four concurrent decorateNow calls. Reconciled the exact continuity blob to gh-pages. Served CI run 36657253335 now proves served/source continuity identity PASS and durable_activity_board_same_work_unit PASS with concurrent_render_unique=true. The suite advances to the next independent boundary page_errors_empty: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'semantic_registry').
